status: UTC checked DateTime arithmetic, signed differences and YMD constructor component; Local timezones, production integration and whole-product qualification remain separate gates.

compiler.bootstrap: Explicit Python B0, followed by native HIA B1, B2, B3 and component compilation.

entry.signature: u64 f0(const u8* source, u64 source_len, u8* output, u64 output_capacity, u8* workspace, u64 workspace_len)
entry.status_encoding: Core u32 zero extended to u64 by the fixed native borrowed-buffer wrapper.

caller_preconditions: Advertised source and output ranges are live for the synchronous call, readable for source and writable for output.
Source and output ranges do not overlap, including exact aliasing. Source is not concurrently modified.
No alignment is required. Lengths are actual allocated capacities; invalid pointers or invented capacities are outside the contract.
Zero-length workspace is never read or written. Native retains no pointers and has no mutable global state.

source.byte_order: eight little-endian u64 words; signed arguments use two's-complement bits

fields.name: operation
fields.meaning: 0: checked DateTime add TimeDelta; 1: checked subtract; 2: signed_duration_since; 3: UTC YMD construction

fields.name: argument_a
fields.meaning: signed left timestamp seconds for operations 0..2; signed year for operation 3

fields.name: argument_b
fields.meaning: left timestamp nanoseconds for operations 0..2; month for operation 3

fields.name: argument_c
fields.meaning: signed canonical TimeDelta seconds for operations 0..1; signed right timestamp seconds for operation 2; day for operation 3

fields.name: argument_d
fields.meaning: canonical TimeDelta nanoseconds for operations 0..1; right timestamp nanoseconds for operation 2; hour for operation 3

fields.name: argument_e
fields.meaning: required zero for operations 0..2; minute for operation 3

fields.name: argument_f
fields.meaning: required zero for operations 0..2; second for operation 3

source.mutation: Never modified; all eight words are loaded before any output write.

output.byte_order: eight little-endian u64 words; signed results use two's-complement bits

fields.name: inputs_valid
fields.value: 1 when the original DateTime and TimeDelta operands, or YMD constructor arguments, are valid; otherwise 0

fields.name: result_valid
fields.value: 1 when the actual result exists; valid operands whose checked operation overflows retain inputs_valid=1 with result_valid=0

fields.name: result_seconds
fields.value: signed timestamp seconds for operations 0,1,3; signed canonical TimeDelta seconds for operation 2; otherwise 0

fields.name: result_nanoseconds
fields.value: DateTime subsecond nanoseconds for operations 0,1,3; canonical nonnegative TimeDelta nanoseconds for operation 2; otherwise 0

fields.name: duration_num_seconds
fields.value: signed original num_seconds() for operation 2; otherwise 0

fields.name: duration_subsec_nanos
fields.value: signed original subsec_nanos() for operation 2; otherwise 0

output.tail: Bytes after offset 64 remain unchanged. Frame and capacity errors leave the entire output unchanged.

semantics.timestamp_fraction: Nanoseconds must be below 2000000000; values at least 1000000000 require the Euclidean second within the minute to be 59. Guard the timestamp range before computing any minute index.
semantics.duration: Match TimeDelta::new exactly: canonical seconds from -9223372036854776 through 9223372036854775, fraction below 1000000000; at the lower endpoint fraction must be at least 193000000, at the upper endpoint at most 807000000. Convert canonical negative fractions to the original truncated num_seconds and signed subsec_nanos before arithmetic.
semantics.addition: Preserve the original NaiveTime leap escape order. On a leap input, a positive whole duration, or a positive fractional duration that reaches fraction 2000000000, first removes one billion from the input fraction. A negative whole duration removes one billion and advances the input second by one. Other fractional-only changes remain within the leap second or the second before. Normal addition then performs a single fraction borrow/carry and enforces the final full DateTime range.
semantics.subtraction: Negate the validated duration's truncated seconds and signed fractional part before applying the same original leap rules. TimeDelta's symmetric total duration bounds ensure both negations are representable.
semantics.difference: The original leap correction compares seconds within the day, including when dates differ: add one second if left time-of-day is later and right is a leap second; otherwise subtract one if left is earlier and left is a leap second. Add the date-aware seconds difference and Euclidean fraction quotient/remainder. Encode the original TimeDelta canonically and also return its actual num_seconds/subsec_nanos accessors. The original observer reconstructs TimeDelta::new and asserts equality with signed_duration_since.
semantics.ymd: Match Utc.with_ymd_and_hms(...).single(): year -262143..262142, valid Gregorian month/day, hour<24, minute<60, second<60. The constructor rejects second 60. Guard year before calendar arithmetic. The reused civil_days helper retains the previously qualified Gregorian rules.
semantics.wide_arguments: Nanoseconds and YMD fields use u64 in the borrowed ABI. The original observer first requires u32 representability for nanos/month/day/hour/minute/second and i32 representability for year; unsupported wider values produce inputs_valid=0. All valid semantic ranges are within these original parameter types.
semantics.scope: UTC checked arithmetic, signed differences and one YMD constructor only. Local timezone operations, month arithmetic, generic TimeDelta public APIs, adapter integration and production callers remain separate.

status_precedence.condition: output capacity is below 64, before reading source or validating workspace
source size is not 64, workspace is nonempty, version is not 1, operation is outside 0..3, or either reserved argument for operations 0..2 is nonzero
valid frame; exactly 64 output bytes encode the actual original operands and operation result; semantic failure preserves version 1 and clears unavailable value fields

differential_corpus.coverage: Every original calendar constructor case as operand in add/sub/difference; all 400 years x 12 months x 31 date slots; dense leap-second duration carry/borrow/escape/stay cases at minute/day/date endpoints; canonical TimeDelta limits and invalid fractions; same-day and different-day leap pairs; wide YMD field guards; deterministic complete-range DateTime pairs and small/extreme durations.
differential_corpus.controls: Two fills and exact/excess output capacities for every semantic case. All 64 shorter output capacities for all four operations; truncated and oversized source, invalid metadata, reserved words for each relevant operation and nonempty workspace. All inputs, outputs, tails and unaligned guards compared.
differential_corpus.recording: Complete input, original output and native-call transcript retained as gzip streams, with SHA-256 hashes of every uncompressed byte.
